title: The Andromeda Strain
author: Michael Crichton
summary: A military satellite crashes near a small Arizona town and nearly everyone there is found dead. A team of scientists is locked inside an underground laboratory to work out what it brought back, and how to stop it.
readIf: you like cool, procedural thrillers with a documentary feel and a ticking clock.
skipIf: you want rounded characters, since the people are mostly vehicles for the investigation.

pairings.reason: The author's later, more adventurous take on science that outruns the people who control it.
A much longer, darker and more human novel about a deadly plague and what comes after.
A quieter, more literary look at the aftermath of a deadly outbreak.
